pool.text: The city was founded by the Pioneer Column as a fort.
The Herald newspaper was founded as the city's oldest newspaper.
The governing Rhodesia Rugby Football Union was founded in the city.
The Salisbury Polo Club was formed in the area.
Salisbury was declared a municipality by the administration.
Southern Rhodesia achieved responsible government and Salisbury became the capital.
Highfield was established as the second-oldest high-density suburb.
Salisbury officially achieved the status of a city.
Salisbury became the capital of the newly established Central African Federation.
The Federation of Rhodesia and Nyasaland was officially dissolved.
Ian Smith's Rhodesian Front government declared Rhodesia independent from the United Kingdom.
The cultural organisation was founded by Roy Guthrie.
The country gained international recognition as independent as the Republic of Zimbabwe.
The city of Salisbury was renamed Harare on the second independence anniversary.
Willowvale became widely known for the Willowgate scandal involving government officials.
Harare hosted the international sporting event known as the All-Africa Games.
Harare served as the host city for the World Council of Churches assembly.
The Cricket World Cup was hosted in the city.
The government carried out Operation Murambatsvina by demolishing shanties and illegal sites.
Harare was voted the world's toughest city to live in according to a poll.
